Class SlotMachine

java.lang.Object
SlotMachine
public class SlotMachine extends Object
Represents a slotMachine, it can add wheels and spin them, if you wanna win, you will need a jackpot.
(symbolsQuantity, wheelsQuantity, lever, rectangleBodyParts, symbols, wheels)
Inv: symbols > 0 and wheels > 0
Version:
1
Author:
David Garzon, Wilson Mendivelso
